title: The Resistance
subtitle: Change Management Crisis & Cultural Friction
description: The workforce is pushing back. A union rep files a concern. Middle management sabotages the training sessions. This is where most transformations die. How do you lead through resistance?

stakeholders.agenda: Concerned biometric attendance tracking infringes on worker privacy.
